reports.title: NYC Daily Digest
reports.tone: tight, skimmable, and friendly — a real morning briefing, not a wall of text
reports.intro: Use web search for live, current data (today's real date, NYC).

sections.label: Weather
sections.want: NYC today: current temp, high/low, rain/snow chance, and a one-line 'what to wear/bring'.

sections.label: Headlines
sections.want: 4-5 top stories (US/world + anything major NYC-specific), one line each, as '• ' bullets.

sections.label: Getting around
sections.want: any notable MTA subway service changes/major delays today (skip if nothing notable).

sections.label: NYC today
sections.want: one or two notable things happening in the city today.

sections.label: Nugget
sections.want: one useful/interesting thing to start the day.
